subject.title: fix(marketplaces): allow trusted feed key rotation

question: Should a snapshot verified under a formerly trusted signing key continue to provide sequence-only rollback metadata after that key is removed from the active trust set?
rationale: This is a deliberate trust-policy choice rather than a mechanical code correction: it enables legitimate key rotation but determines the residual authority retained from a revoked key.

options.title: Accept retained monotonic metadata
options.body: Treat a previously authenticated snapshot as eligible to enforce rollback ordering across future key rotations, while retaining the existing fail-closed checks for all other snapshot use.

options.title: Require rotation epochs or explicit reset
options.body: Keep key revocation fully authoritative by adding an owner-defined epoch or reset mechanism instead of carrying sequence state across a trust-root change.

recommendation.title: Accept retained monotonic metadata
recommendation.body: Treat a previously authenticated snapshot as eligible to enforce rollback ordering across future key rotations, while retaining the existing fail-closed checks for all other snapshot use.

likelyOwner.reason: The contributor is actively working on the paired signed-feed trust design and can provide the immediate security-boundary rationale; a repository owner should make the final policy call.
